qualitative.gate_2_reason: Non-essential / easily forgone product or service. Self-storage is an optional convenience used during moves or clutter accumulation rather than an essential necessity or everyday habit.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (Essential Western Need & Entrenched Habits, REJECT). Self-storage is an optional, deferrable service tied to moving activity and clutter storage rather than an essential functional need or daily habit. Easily forgone or vacated during economic tightening.
qualitative.evidence: Extra Space Storage operates >3,700 locations following the $14B Life Storage merger. Self-storage demand is discretionary and non-essential, subject to housing turnover cycles and high customer churn. Capital efficiency is structurally sub-hurdle (5Y median GAAP ROIC of 5-7% vs 12% requirement), and debt load is heavy ($11B+ debt vs ~$800M net income).
